market.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (LOW) $85 in May?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$101.79 May 4. Dropping LOW to $85 in May requires ~16.5% decline from spot — a substantial move not justified by current supply/demand even if Iran ceasefire holds. OPEC+ would likely intervene before $85. May 1 prints near $106 make this even less likely as the spread to $85 is large.
assessment.key_uncertainty: A demand-side recession shock or OPEC discipline failure could accelerate downside.
